## Description

R28: `tests/test_cli_packaging.py` passes.

## Approach

`pyproject.toml` now lists `dashboard` and `installer`, but the install fixtures copy only `orchestra` and `scripts`. Extend the copy list in `tests/test_cli_packaging.py` and `tests/integration/test_declared_install.py` to include `dashboard` and `installer`. Do not change idea or composer tests. Do not edit `tests/test_wheel_contents.py`. Do not write idea or engage worktrees.
